The '''Siskeen theater''' was one of the six theaters of operations of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], which took place during the final stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Astrography==
The Siskeen theater was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]].<ref name="TEA" /> This field of operations was named after the key [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Siskeen/Legends|Siskeen]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==History==
In the Siskeen theater, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|forces]] were deployed from [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]] and [[Excarga/Legends|Excarga]] to clear the outer Corellian Run of Separatist units.<ref name="TEGtW" />
